topic: Wartime maintenance, procedure, authority to employ war time maintenance procedure schedule maintenance, component life defect rectification
syllabus_extract: Wartime maintenance, procedure, authority to employ war time maintenance procedure schedule maintenance, component life defect rectification and repair, BDR recovery to peace time documentation.
specific_objectives: 1.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to understand modification, life categories and flight-testing effect of CG variation and wartime maintenance procedure.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of Wartime Maintenance Procedure Schedule (WMS) and Component Life Defect Rectification Log entries; Instructor supervision of documentation recovery simulation.
intro_questions: What is the primary difference between peace-time and wartime maintenance priorities?
Who holds the authority to authorize Wartime Maintenance Procedures?
Why is Component Life Defect Rectification critical during operational phases?

topics: Definition and scope of Wartime Maintenance
Authority to employ Wartime Maintenance Procedure
development.content:
Definition and scope of Wartime Maintenance
Authority to employ Wartime Maintenance Procedure
WMS Schedule maintenance requirements
Component life categories and limits
Defect rectification and repair protocols

topics: BDR recovery to peace time documentation
Recording wartime repairs in permanent records
development.content:
Modification impact on CG variation
Flight-testing effects of CG changes
BDR recovery to peace time documentation
Recording wartime repairs in permanent records
Verification of life limits post-rectification

Safety precautions during wartime repairs
Instructor supervision of defect rectification
Tool control during emergency maintenance
Final inspection before flight release
Reporting chain for wartime anomalies

summary_questions: Explain the conditions under which Wartime Maintenance Procedures are authorized.
Describe the steps required to recover BDR entries to peace-time documentation standards.
How does CG variation affect flight testing and what modifications are required?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief summary of the Wartime Maintenance Procedure Schedule (WMS) and outline the specific steps for transitioning BDR entries to peace-time documentation, referencing the next lesson on Tool Control System requirements.

pft_rows.syllabus: Tool control system – introduction and need of tool control set up, Tool control procedures, duties and responsibilities of tool controller, maintenance of tool out fits and procedure for use of forms TC-14, TC-15, LP tool procurement and survey/ demand of tool.
